scripts.test: for d in packages/* services/* apps/phone infra; do [ ! -f $d/package.json ] || (cd $d && npm test --if-present) || exit 1; done
scripts.typecheck: for d in packages/* services/* apps/phone infra; do [ ! -f $d/package.json ] || (cd $d && npm run typecheck --if-present) || exit 1; done
